tagline: Unite caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world
hero_kpi_rationale: Revenue from Mounjaro/Zepbound is the primary growth driver today, fueling the company's overall performance through its dominance in the GLP-1 segment for diabetes and obesity.

kpis.name: Revenue from top drug
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the company's flagship product, here Mounjaro/Zepbound, based on GLP-1.
kpis.description: Mounjaro (diabetes) and Zepbound (obesity) experienced strong growth in 2025, driving overall revenue increase.

kpis.name: Advanced R&D pipeline phases
kpis.explanation: Number of molecules in phase 3 of clinical development, the final stage before approval.
kpis.description: In 2025, Lilly had 16 programs in phase 3 including retatrutide, orforglipron, eloralintide, lepodisiran, muvalaplin, brenipatide and multiple indications for tirzepatide.

kpis.name: Operating margin (Core)
kpis.explanation: Profit margin after operating costs, excluding significant amortization.
kpis.description: Operating margin improved in 2025 to 39.5%, driven by 45% revenue growth and gross margin improvement, partially offset by increases in R&D and SG&A.
kpis.signal: Margin improvement due to strong demand for key products.

kpis.name: R&D investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development expenses in total revenue.
kpis.description: Lilly continues to invest heavily in R&D to renew its portfolio, particularly in metabolic and neurological treatments. In 2025, R&D spending was 13,337M / 65,179M revenue = 20.4%.
kpis.signal: Optimal investment rate reflecting improved R&D efficiency despite revenue growth.

kpis.name: Free cash flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated after operating and investing expenses.
kpis.description: FCF increased significantly in 2025, reflecting the robustness of the business model and 45% revenue growth, enabling strategic investments in manufacturing capacity.
kpis.signal: Strong FCF growth, supported by demand for key products.

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from drug and product sales.
kpis.description: Revenue surged in 2025 to 65,179M (+45% vs 45,043M in 2024), primarily driven by Mounjaro and Zepbound despite lower realized prices due to government agreements negotiated in November 2025.
kpis.signal: Exceptional growth driven by GLP-1 products.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $65.179 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $20.64 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $1.73 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $5.384 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 26.1% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Recent FDA approval
kpis.explanation: Drug recently approved by the FDA, with recent launch.
kpis.description: In 2025, Zepbound (tirzepatide) was approved by the FDA for the treatment of obesity in adults, marking a strategic turning point and significantly expanding the market opportunity beyond type 2 diabetes.
kpis.signal: Zepbound approved for obesity, opening a massive market.

kpis.name: Positive phase 3 result
kpis.explanation: Positive outcome from a phase 3 clinical trial, often binary for valuation.
kpis.description: In 2025, the phase 3 trial of retatrutide in obesity succeeded by meeting all primary and key secondary endpoints, strengthening the post-tirzepatide pipeline and validating the triple GLP-1/GIP/glucagon mechanism of action.
kpis.signal: Retatrutide met primary endpoints in obesity and other indications.

kpis.name: Multi-site production capex
kpis.explanation: Multi-year investments in production capacity to meet demand.
kpis.description: In 2025, Lilly significantly increased investments in production capacity to address strong demand for Mounjaro/Zepbound and historical capacity constraints, with multi-site geographic deployment.
kpis.signal: Massive capex to address Mounjaro/Zepbound shortages and support future growth.

risks.title: Failure in new product development
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, mentioned first and repeated multiple times in the risk section. The language is strong: 'high rate of failure', 'material adverse effect'. It concerns the sustainability of the pipeline amid scientific and regulatory uncertainty. Weighted at maximum as it relates to the survival of the business model. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased competition in biologics and GLP-1
risks.score_rationale: Positioned early in the text, with alarming language: 'intense competition', 'material adverse effect'. Specific mention of a saturated GLP-1 market and biosimilar risk for Mounjaro/Zepbound. Risk amplified by the importance of metabolic products in the growth portfolio. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Revenue loss due to price regulation
risks.score_rationale: Cited with concrete examples (Jardiance selected in 2023, Trulicity and Verzenio selected in January 2026) and direct financial impacts. Strong language: 'government-set prices', 'significant discount', 'meaningfully influence our business strategies'. Voluntary agreements negotiated in November 2025. Highly weighted category in healthcare. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on a few key products
risks.score_rationale: Mounjaro/Zepbound represent a disproportionate share of 2025 growth. Explicit dependence on GLP-1 creates vulnerability to patent expiry (in 8-12 years) or market saturation. Less immediately existential than regulatory risks but critical for growth sustainability. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Integration issues following acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights integration risks, value dilution, and unforeseen costs. Language: 'substantial asset impairment', 'fail to generate expected revenue'. Recent acquisitions including Adverum (Ixo-vec). A 2,910M IPR&D charge in 2025 reflects such pressures. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Access pressures and reimbursement policies
risks.score_rationale: Detailed discussion of voluntary government negotiations in November 2025, risks of insufficient access expansion, price-volume imbalance. Language: 'risks and uncertainty', 'may fail to adequately capitalize', 'negatively impact pricing strategies'. Direct impact on future revenues. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: The company did not mention AI, artificial intelligence, or machine learning in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F report. Therefore, its positioning on these technologies cannot be determined from this information.
